product_purpose: 검증된 언어·문화 근거를 바탕으로 이름 붙이기 어려운 마음의 표현을 탐색하는 비진단적 카드 경험
card_id_policy: Stable C#### concept IDs; revisions preserve card_id unless concept identity was wrong.
evidence_policy: Public cards require validated lexical and scholarly evidence, pronunciation provenance, cultural review, rights checks and Human Editorial Release.
privacy_policy_summary: Public tools expose validated public card data only. User-written local notes remain on-device and are not exposed to agents by default.
editorial_boundary: Public agent tools are read-only and cannot mutate repositories, publication state, remote storage, or bypass editorial gates.
